description: This Java class defines an exception called AcknowledgementRequestParseException, which is thrown when parsing an acknowledgement request from a string representation fails. It extends DittoRuntimeException and is annotated as an immutable, parsable exception with associated error code and message templates. The class includes constructors for creating instances from a string, cause, headers, and JSON representations, along with a builder class for mutable construction.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequestParseException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception that occurs when parsing an acknowledgement request fails. It includes static factory methods, error code constants, message templates, and an inner builder class for constructing instances with specific attributes.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequestParseException.Builder
classes.description: A static inner class extending DittoRuntimeExceptionBuilder to facilitate building instances of AcknowledgementRequestParseException with customized fields like message, description, cause, href, and headers.

methods.description: Public constructor creating an exception with a string representation of the acknowledgement request, an optional cause, and headers.

methods.description: Private static method building the exception message string, appending cause message if present.
